description: Gauhati Medical College Unveils Groundbreaking AI-Enabled Healthcare Initiative.
body_lead: CM Himanta Biswa Sarma Leads Assam’s AI Hospital Push with Lord’s Mark Industries Gauhati Medical College Unveils Groundbreaking AI-Enabled Healthcare Initiative. In a landmark step towards redefining India’s public healthcare infrastructure, Lord’s Mark Industries Ltd today announced the successful installation of the world’s first AI-based, contactless remote patient monitoring system at Gauhati Medical College and Hospital (GMCH). The advanced system has been deployed in a step-down ICU ward as part of the newly inaugurated medical college complex.
